svg.aria-label: Xcode: Opens Package.swift directly, without a separate Xcode project.; VS Code, Cursor and Zed: Understand Swift through the official Swift extension or out of the box.; Neovim, Helix and others: Talk to sourcekit-lsp, the language server that comes with Xcode.; JetBrains IDEs: Edit the files; building and checking happen in the terminal.
